messages:
noah.mkt: Need a small, brand-safe asset set for next week's benchmark launch. Scope: 1 hero (1200x628), 1 square tile (800x800), 1 SVG schematic (latency vs cost with 3 icons), and 2 email header sizes. 48h turnaround ideal. Can design take it?

sasha.design: We can if scoped tight. Confirm sizes and exports: SVG for schematic (vectors only), PNG@2x for tiles, Figma components with brand tokens. Any copy constraints?

emily.pm: Prioritize schematic + hero first, then square tile, then headers. Schematic should call out batching, KV cache, quantization with short captions. Use Redwood palette only.

toni.writer: Copy ready. Two headline options in Figma comments. I'll add alt-text per frame. Legal asks to avoid unapproved trademarks and superlatives.

sasha.design: Timeline: wireframes in 18h, comps in 36h, final exports in 48h. Will include dark-mode social variant and logo-free partner variant. Exports: SVG (diagram), PNG@2x (tiles/headers), Figma components, and a one-paragraph usage note.

legal-bot: Reminder: the phrase "Redwood Serving" is trademarked. Use fallback phrasing if approval not received.

noah.mkt: Good. Please tag reviewers in Figma and drop 1-line alt text in comments. Scheduling 30-min review after first comps. Thanks team :thumbsup:

figma-bot: File updated by sasha.design  5 frames added  comments enabled.

sasha.design: Posted first frames. Tagging emily + noah for review. Will update thread with exports.
